DIRECTIONAL AND POSITIONAL STRENGTHS : Jupiter and Mercury have directional strength while in the ascendant (i.e. East), the Sun and Mars in the 10th (i.e. South), Saturn in the 7th (1.6. West) and the Moon and Venus in the 4th (ie. North). If a planet is in exaltation, Mulatrikona, own house, friendly house or own Navamsa and aspected by a benefic, it assumes strength. The Moon and Venus are strong in even Rasis while the rest are so in odd Rasis. This is called positional strength. _ Notes: Digbala or directional strength is found thus : Take the case of Jupiter.
